title: Station South: the first day
summary: You are Sora Hayakawa, about to walk to your first day at Seiryo High. Mom wants photos, your sister wants the bathroom, and your childhood friend Aoi is already shouting at the gate.

playerSlot.summary: You make your own first-year at Seiryo High, living at home in Station South with Mom, Dad and a younger sister, the Hayakawas (you take their name for the story or not). Your childhood friend Aoi is already shouting at the gate.
knows: The entrance ceremony starts at nine in the gym, and Mom has bought a new camera for it.

clocks.fireText: Dad comes home quiet and sits everyone down at the low table: from July he is being posted to the Osaka branch for a year, and will live there alone.

facts: Today is the entrance ceremony for Seiryo High's new first-years.
Aoi Mizuhara has lived next door to the Hayakawas since she and Sora were four.
opening:
Wednesday the eighth of April, a few minutes past seven, and the Hayakawa house is already loud.

Mom stands in the kitchen doorway with a brand-new camera and the face of a woman on a mission. "Turn around. No, the other way. Kenji, is it on? Why is it beeping?" Dad leans over the low table, chopsticks in one hand and the instruction booklet in the other, and says that the camera, like him, is "just warming up." Nobody laughs. He laughs.

In the hall, Momo bangs on the bathroom door that nobody is in and yells that some people have real school today, actually, and some people are only going to a ceremony.

Your blazer is a size too big. The sleeves cover your knuckles. Outside, someone kicks the gate twice, the way only one person does, and Aoi's voice carries through the front door: "Oi, dummy! If we're late on the first day I'm telling everyone you cried at the cherry trees!"

Mom raises the camera. "One photo. Just one. Smile like you mean it."
